description: Supported {de, fr, ja, zu} with the fallback set to ja, which is neither first nor last in sorted order. That separates the two rules in DefaultStrings.preferredLocaleForWildcard (DefaultStrings.java:1955): prefer the configured fallback when it survives, otherwise take the first surviving supported locale. A fixture whose fallback happened to sort first could not tell those apart, and having two locales sort ahead of the fallback lets a second exclusion prove the second rule really walks sorted order.
